status: Curvature-fit candidate: actual native review and performance pending
scope: Three-dimensional jointed masses on exposed steep walls, within the existing Outcrop instancing/culling/nearby-collider system. No change to the authoritative heightfield or unrelated vegetation density.
placement: Reuse main rock lattice samples; eligible exposed or thin-soil rock gets bounded height-only slope probes. Only slopes above about52degrees and at least8m local relief create masses. Submerged ground, glacier biome and mobile sand are excluded.
geometry: Three CC0 scanned fronts, affine front-plane calibrated, explicit flat backs with manifold volume; near/mid/far caps 3200/1050/260 triangles. No solidify modifier.
collision: Use nearby nonconvex surface colliders plus existing physical terrain. Faces lean along the sampled wall normal and are centered into the wall; do not float upright above it.

controls.timing_limit: Background component costs are not frame-time measurements

research_application: Keep efficient height terrain for broad ground and use actual solid mesh geometry where a heightfield cannot represent projecting roofs. This pass adds ledges, not underground tunnel excavation.

prototype_rejection.reason: Regular stacked block pattern and double-multiplied dark rock colour were visually unacceptable

material_fix: Marked cliff material uses full generated stone albedo with only a small tint, rather than multiplying two full stone colours; normal strength is restrained. Other rock/item materials retain their existing behavior.

rejected_scan_conversion.reason: Solidifying acute scan cracks created spikes; upright placement also protruded above slopes

rejected_open_conversion.reason: Front datum buried most of the face; open outer edges appeared as thin panels

rejected_closed_conversion.reason: Stretched proportions and exposed perimeter fragments; neutral rock material mismatched blended host terrain

rejected_rim_conversion.reason: Colour improved but large plane fit exposed backing on curved terrace walls. Added shrink/reject fit across eight footprint controls; minimum inner front relief and stricter front-ledged roof check.
